questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of translating technical findings into business decisions?

options.text: To enable stakeholders to act on insights

questions.explanation: It ensures stakeholders can make informed decisions based on insights.

questions.prompt: Which communication technique best helps explain statistical significance to a non-technical audience?

options.text: Provide raw p-values and confidence intervals
Show the code used for calculations

questions.explanation: Analogies and visuals translate abstract concepts into familiar terms.

questions.prompt: When presenting model results for a marketing campaign, which metric should you emphasize to demonstrate ROI?
questions.explanation: Lift measures how much more likely a target group is to convert, directly tied to ROI.

questions.prompt: How can you address stakeholders' concerns about potential bias in a predictive model?

options.text: Explain the data preprocessing steps only
Show fairness metrics and mitigation strategies
Provide the model code for review

questions.explanation: Demonstrating fairness metrics and mitigation shows proactive bias handling.

questions.prompt: What strategy best integrates stakeholder feedback into an iterative data science project?

options.text: Collect feedback at the end of the project only
Build a feedback loop with regular demos and updates
Ignore feedback to avoid scope creep
Let stakeholders decide the model architecture

questions.explanation: Regular demos keep stakeholders engaged and allow incremental adjustments.

questions.prompt: Which visualization most effectively conveys seasonality in a time series to stakeholders?

options.text: Heat map of day-of-week vs. month

questions.explanation: Seasonal subseries plot isolates patterns per season, making seasonality clear.
